title: New Staff Induction Guide
summary: A practical summary of the standards every new employee needs from day one.
body:
## 1. PURPOSE OF THIS GUIDE

This guide gives new employees a practical summary of the standards they need from day one. It does not replace the Staff Handbook (PEL-POL-001) or your contract of employment.

## 2. WELCOME TO PELAGOS

- Pelagos is a premium-casual restaurant focused on quality, consistency and real hospitality.
- Be warm, polished, respectful and reliable in every interaction.
- Guests must feel welcome from arrival to departure.

## 3. FIRST-DAY ESSENTIALS

- Arrive on time and in full uniform.
- Bring your identification and any documents requested by management.
- Sign the Fingerprint Clocking Consent form (PEL-FRM-002) so that your fingerprint can be registered on Pilot. From then on, clock in and out on Pilot at every shift (Staff Handbook, section 4.4).
- Know who your manager, supervisor or trainer is for the shift.
- Ask questions early rather than guessing.

## 4. CONDUCT RULES

- Be respectful to guests, colleagues, residents and suppliers.
- No gossip, shouting, arguments or personal drama in guest areas.
- No alcohol or drugs while on duty or before reporting for work.
- No unauthorised use of company property, stock or information.

## 5. SERVICE BASICS

- Acknowledge every guest within 30 seconds, even if you are busy.
- Greet guests as Mr, Mrs or Ms with their surname, or by their first name once they offer it. Do not use “ma’am”.
- Smile, make eye contact and listen before responding.
- If you do not know the answer, say “Let me find out for you.”
- Repeat orders back and communicate allergies or changes clearly.
- Pelagos is cashless: we never accept cash from a guest. If a guest offers cash, politely explain this and offer to take payment by card.

## 6. HYGIENE AND APPEARANCE

- Your uniform must be clean, pressed and complete (Staff Handbook, section 7.2).
- Closed, non-slip shoes are compulsory.
- Hair must be neat and tied back where required.
- Wash your hands often and keep your nails short and clean. Kitchen staff may not wear nail polish or false nails.

## 7. MOBILE PHONES AND BREAKS

- Personal phones may not be kept on your person while on duty unless management authorises it.
- At the start of your shift, store your phone in your locker or hand it in at the Duty Manager’s office. Use it only during approved breaks (Staff Handbook, section 6.3).
- Take your breaks outside the restricted periods and return on time, ready to work (Staff Handbook, section 4.2).

## 8. FOOD SAFETY REMINDERS

- Follow FIFO and labelling rules.
- Keep raw and cooked foods separate.
- Use the correct colour-coded boards and clean as you go.
- Report anything unsafe immediately.

## 9. ESTATE RULES

- Use approved estate access points and follow security instructions.
- Park only in authorised areas.
- Behave professionally on the estate at all times.
- Report suspicious behaviour or incidents immediately.

## 10. EMERGENCIES

- Stay calm and inform management immediately.
- Follow evacuation, fire, medical or security instructions without delay.
- Never hide an accident, injury or unsafe condition.
- Estate 24/7 emergency number: **081 829 3355**. Ambulance: **10177** (or **112** from a cellphone).

## 11. WHERE TO FIND MORE

| **Document**    | **What it covers**                                                                                                    |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **PEL-POL-001** | Staff Handbook: the full rules, including breaks, clocking, pay, leave, public holidays, phones, uniforms and hygiene |
| **PEL-POL-002** | Disciplinary Code and Probation Policy                                                                                |
| **PEL-SOP-001** | Steps of Service (front of house)                                                                                     |
| **PEL-SOP-007** | Kitchen Hygiene (kitchen staff)                                                                                       |
| **PEL-MAN-004** | FOH Training Manual (front of house training)                                                                         |
| **PEL-MEM-015** | Hourly pay calendar (cut-off dates and paydays)                                                                       |

## 12. RELATED DOCUMENTS

- PEL-SOP-011 Staff Onboarding (Day 1 induction)
- PEL-POL-001 Staff Handbook
- PEL-FRM-001 SOP and Memo Acknowledgement Record
- PEL-FRM-002 Fingerprint Clocking Consent Form
